name: Kokoro no Kakera o Atsumete ~Homunculus Malum no Seichouki~
original_name: ココロのかけらを集めて～ホムンクルス・マルムの成長記～
source:
Protagonist Malm is an incomplete homunculus. She has to develop and grow as a human in a limited time. And with that, love comes alongside lots of exciting events.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角马尔姆是一个不完整的人造人。她必须在有限的时间内发展和成长为一个人。随之而来的是，爱情伴随着许多令人兴奋的事件。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
